en: Colorized historical postcard showing a large military parade ground bordered by long white barrack buildings with red roofs on the right and multi‑story red‑brick buildings on the left. Groups of soldiers in dark uniforms stand in formation on the open field. The sky is lightly clouded and tinted blue and yellow. German text identifying Kamenz and a barracks complex is printed at the top.
